abstract: A 40-year-old female presented with pain and enlargement of abdomen since last 6 months. A mass was felt over right iliac fossa. Ultrasonography showed partly cystic and solid area in mass arising from ovary. A tooth-like structure was also seen. Dermoid cyst was the diagnosis offered. Laparotomy was performed. Ovarian mass with hair, a tooth and putty-like material was present. Solid white area with thickened wall was found. Histopathology confirmed the findings of dermoid cyst and the thickened area showed squamous cell carcinoma with areas showing keratinous material and giant cell reaction which was also seen at the periphery of tumor areas. Left ovary was normal and no deposits of tumor were seen. Postoperative period was uneventful.
abstract_ja: 40歳の女性が、腹部膨満感と腹痛を訴えて半年前から受診した。右腸骨窩に腫瘤を触知した。超音波検査では、卵巣由来の一部嚢胞性・一部充実性の領域が認められ、歯牙様構造も見られたため、類皮嚢腫が疑われた。開腹術を行ったところ、毛髪、歯牙、およびクリーム状物質を含む卵巣腫瘤が認められた。肥厚した壁の白色充実性部分が認められた。病理組織学的検査では類皮嚢腫の所見が確認されたが、肥厚部は角化物質と腫瘍周辺部に認められた巨細胞反応を伴う扁平上皮癌であることが判明した。左卵巣は正常で、腫瘍の播種は認められなかった。術後経過は順調であった。
